- your **email address**, **or**
- your **first name + last name + zip code**.

Also, if you have it handy, include your **order id** (e.g., #W0000000).
Sure, my name is Lei Wilson and my zip code is 32255. I don’t have my order ID right now, but I can give you more details about the laptop if needed.

Thanks, Lei—I found your account: **lei_wilson_4541**.

Please share **one** of the following so I can find the right order:

2) the **approx. delivery date** (or month) and the **laptop configuration details** you received (e.g., RAM/SSD/storage/CPU), and I’ll use that to identify the correct order from your order history.

Which would you prefer to provide?

I don’t have the order ID handy, but I can give you the details. The laptop I received is a 15-inch model with 16GB of RAM. It was delivered just a few days ago, earlier this week. Let me know if you need any more specifics!
